verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's docs mention Rovo AI features (docs-5) and Atlassian publishes an official MCP server (probe-4), but that MCP server exposes Bitbucket/Jira tools to other agents — it is not evidence that Bitbucket itself can consume external MCP servers to extend its own tool-use. No evidence describes Bitbucket or Rovo acting as an MCP client. Missing for 10: any documentation of configuring/plugging third-party MCP servers into Bitbucket/Rovo, and any evidence it can call external MCP tools.
